parent_evidence: U5.R2W0 accepts same-look/different-content supervision as a useful reference-matching experiment while rejecting NFRM as an established film algorithm
U5.R2O0 supplies a validated cube-preserving explicit colour flow
U5.R2S1 and U5.R2S2 show that marginal histograms and palette scores are content-dominated
U5.R2S3 shows that reducing pooled distribution loss does not identify the hidden operator
hypothesis: a factorized spatially invariant descriptor trained on repeated same-known-look and different-generated-content groups may retrieve or regress the hidden bounded colour operator with less content dependence than raw marginal histograms
epistemic_scope: generated development evidence for reference-look representation and explicit-operator recovery only; not real pixels, film, stock, calibrated grading or general unpaired-operator identification

execution_order.w1_activation_after: S4 reaches a valid repeated decision and, when its branch activates U1, U1 also reaches a valid repeated decision; their scientific outcome does not rewrite this frozen W1 contract

owner_anchor_strength_path.required_interpretation: one direction with continuous strength, never three categorical modes

content_generator.single_reference_evaluation: score each heldout query group independently
content_generator.four_reference_evaluation: aggregate fixed descriptors from heldout query groups 4-7 symmetrically
content_generator.ridge_regularization_selection: group cross-validation inside fit groups 0-3 only

reference_nuisance.claim_limit: does not model arbitrary camera, RAW, HDR, scanner or prior-grade canonicalization

information_regimes.query: one final styled reference from a heldout content group
information_regimes.look_bank: same operator instances, different development content groups

information_regimes.query: four final styled references from unrelated heldout content groups
one final styled reference whose base direction is excluded from all fitting and bank construction
four final styled references sharing one unseen base direction
exact pre-look and post-look observations for one generated content group

forbidden_components: hidden operator coefficients or oracle grid

ridge_alpha_selection.single_reference: four joint group-direction folds; fold k validates direction ids with id mod 4 equal k and content group k, fitting all other fit directions and content groups
ridge_alpha_selection.four_reference: four direction folds over symmetric group-0-3 aggregates; fold k validates directions with id mod 4 equal k and fits the other directions

methods.description: hard direction over piecewise-linear descriptor paths with continuous parameter-space strength

evaluation.operator_truth: hidden uniform-grid outputs and coefficients used only after prediction for evaluation
evaluation.same_look_replicate: independent heldout content and nuisance groups
evaluation.content_nuisance_probe: ridge one-hot probe on within-look-centred predicted velocity grids; fit directions 0-23, test unseen directions 24-31
evaluation.ood: deferred conditional child; W1D does not generate OOD rows or fit an abstention threshold before a practical operator method passes

paired_upper_bound_optimization.development_scope: unseen directions 24-31 at all four strengths, one heldout content group each

allowed_actions: generate all development contents, nuisances and looks programmatically
reuse the validated U5.R2O0 explicit flow and existing synthetic utilities
fit fixed descriptor normalization and ridge only on development groups
use the local RTX 5070 Ti Laptop if beneficial
run exact repeated development reports and focused leakage, strength, identity and structure tests
forbidden_actions: execute before the current S4 and U1 leaves have valid repeated decisions
access any reserved confirmation seed during development
use film, Commons, YFCC, FiveK or other project photograph pixels
expose content ids, nuisance parameters, hidden coefficients or oracle grids to output-only methods
reuse samples, scenes or palettes across heldout groups
train a neural encoder or any direct final-RGB model
use generative-AI-derived images, edits, embeddings or teachers
use one embedding for both look selection and content/application routing
change methods, seeds, splits, thresholds or gates after development results

branches.seen_retrieval_only_passes: retain a bounded hard reference-bank retriever; do not claim unseen-look regression
branches.paired_upper_bound_only_passes: close practical output-only inference as unidentified
branches.content_or_nuisance_control_fails: close the descriptor without capacity rescue
branches.unseen_regression_passes: open only untouched synthetic confirmation before considering a small parameter-only predictor
branches.structure_or_repeat_fails: invalidate and debug only the explicit operator or deterministic boundary

required_before_pixels: repeated same-look groups independent of scene content and source

claim_ceiling: generated development evidence for or against fixed reference descriptors and explicit-operator retrieval/regression across unrelated generated content; never real-image, film, stock, calibrated, professional-preference or general unpaired-operator identification
